verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents its own SDK, installed as an npm package with prompt and capture hooks, which covers JS/TS instrumentation. No Python SDK is named anywhere. The framework list includes Python-based frameworks, but that does not show a first-party Python SDK. missing for 10: explicitly documented official Python SDK, TypeScript-specific SDK documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of either SDK.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Install the npm package and connect your agent’s prompt and capture hooks.
The SDK waits at most 1,000 ms per user turn, and you can set a shorter limit.
Capture uploads a full snapshot in the background.
